checks.name: official_express_contract_inventory
checks.evidence: Reviewed the current official Vietnam Express documentation for authentication, list-available-services, estimate/order, create-order, orders/{id}, list-user-orders, cancel-order, place/geocode, and webhooks.

checks.name: implemented_door_to_door_types
checks.evidence: All fields used by the current partner_pay Door-to-door estimate and booking flow are compatible with the official schemas. Response order_time accepts both the documented numeric string and the numeric value observed in production.

checks.name: cod_and_cash_payer_request_contract
checks.evidence: XanhSmAddonRequest does not model remain_cod or value, and XanhSmDeliveryPointRequest does not model the point-level addons object or is_payment_check_point boolean. COD and explicit cash-payer requests cannot be represented.

checks.name: geocode_contract
checks.evidence: The official GET place/geocode API and its response model are not implemented in the XanhSM client.

checks.name: webhook_contract
checks.evidence: No XanhSM webhook envelope, event payload DTOs, or HMAC signature handling were found. Official event_time is an integer, but the documentation is internally inconsistent about seconds versus milliseconds.

checks.name: documented_numeric_precision
checks.evidence: A few DTO fields use double where the documentation says integer, including service max/min distance and express package max weight. These are wider compatible types and do not create deserialization failures.

checks.name: xanhsm_regression_tests
checks.evidence: dotnet test filtered to FullyQualifiedName~XanhSm passed 23/23 tests.

checks.name: production_endpoint_after_deployment
checks.evidence: The order_time compatibility change has not been deployed from this workspace, and no dedicated customer test token was provided for authenticated live contract probes.

failures: COD addon fields and point-level payment/addon fields are missing from request DTOs.
The official geocode API is not represented by the client.
The official webhook contract and signature verification are not implemented.
Production verification remains pending deployment and an authenticated test request.
redactions: No JWT, XanhSM credential, customer data, or raw provider response body was recorded.
